def test_myhome_friendship_status_change(self):
        try:
            # 初始化发现页操作类（传入self即可复用所有minium对象）
            home_page = HomePage(self)

            # 链式调用公共方法，逻辑清晰
            home_page.goto_home_page()

            self.page.wait_for(
                lambda: self.page.element_is_exists(home_myhome_element, max_timeout=max_timeout),
                max_timeout=max_timeout)

            # 点击我的主页 btn
            completeInfo_title_myhome_btn = self.page.get_element(home_myhome_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            completeInfo_title_myhome_btn.tap()
            time.sleep(5)

            current_status = self.page.element_is_exists(home_tab_current_status_business_element,max_timeout=max_timeout)

            if current_status:

                # 切换为休闲
                self.page.wait_for(
                    lambda: self.page.element_is_exists(myhome_business_status_image_src, max_timeout=max_timeout),
                    max_timeout=max_timeout)

                status_popup = self.page.get_element(myhome_business_status_image_src, max_timeout=max_timeout)
                status_popup.tap()
                # 选择休闲
                status_list = self.page.get_elements(myhome_no_select_status_element,
                                                       max_timeout=max_timeout)
                for current_status in status_list:
                    if current_status.text == myhome_status_item_left_friendship_status_tag:
                        current_status.tap()

                timestamp = time.strftime("%H%M%S")
                self.capture(f"个人说明书已切换至休闲状态_{timestamp}.png")
            else:
                timestamp = time.strftime("%H%M%S")
                self.capture(f"个人说明书当前状态已是休闲_{timestamp}.png")

        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"个人说明书状态 休闲 切换失败：{str(e)}")
            # 异常时截图
            timestamp = time.strftime("%H%M%S")
            self.capture(f"个人说明书切换休闲状态_{timestamp}.png")
            raise

        timestamp = time.strftime("%H%M%S")
        self.capture(f"个人说明书切换休闲状态_{timestamp}.png", region=self.page)
        time.sleep(2)
